text:
olivia: Planning to publish the user-facing launch post Mon 09:00am PT. Need final changelog URL, live docs link, the canary window, and a single-sentence benchmark blurb for the hero. cc @ben @yana @leo

ben: Changelog is at https://redwood.in/changelog/v1.6.1-draft — will merge Fri 5pm PT. Canary plan: Sun 8pm PT start, 15% for 45m, check metrics, then 60% for 90m before final flip Mon 08:30am PT.

yana: Docs will be published Sun 7:30pm PT at https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.6.1. I'll add a brief "Topline" paragraph; marketing please provide the 20-word headline and social copy.

leo: Benchmark short line: "~20% lower median token latency on 8k+ prompts; 2x better sustained throughput at high concurrency." Use the simpler social: "Faster, more consistent inference for long-context apps."

olivia: Perfect. Sales asks: add tracking params so inbound signups from the blog route to the trials+Dedic queue. Ben can you append UTM tags to both changelog and docs?

ben: Will add ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=v1_6_1 before publish. No legal holds. Partner embargo window: Mon 8:45am PT (15m before public).

leo: Ops note — we'll gate the new quant profiles behind ff_quant_v1_6 and toggle in canary only. Runbook snippet: ```bash
redwoodctl rollout start --release=v1.6.1 --canary=15 --timeout=45m
redwoodctl feature toggle ff_quant_v1_6 --on --env=canary
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: Sun 2024-05-12T20:00:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall and #release-health.

yana: Docs link live: https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.6.1 — added Topline: "Smoothed latency and more efficient batching for long-context inference; safer rollouts via feature flags."

olivia: Marketing will finalize blog + social by Sun 6pm PT and schedule for Mon 09:00am PT. Leo — please confirm you can present a short benchmark slide at the webinar Mon 10:30am PT.

leo: Confirmed. I'll drop the slide and the canary health channel link in this thread when the rollout starts.

olivia: Action summary: Ben — merge changelog + add UTMs; Yana — confirm docs header and CTA (done); Leo — slide + monitor canary; Marketing — finalize copy and schedule. I'll post a preflight checklist Sun 6pm PT. :rocket:
